P_sunrise.basis: Until the sun has risen a spear's length; conventional interval, scholar to set final value.

P_zenith.basis: Istiwāʾ window before zawāl; scholar to set final value.

P_isfirar.basis: Shāfiʿī prohibition strictly attaches to the setting itself; window parameter kept for display symmetry, scholar to confirm.

anchor_convention.basis: Shāfiʿī basis is after performing Fajr/Asr; anchored conservatively to prayer-time entry. Scholar to confirm.

fardCurrent.basis: Obligatory prayer is never barred by the prohibited times.

qada.basis: Prayers with a cause (dhāt sabab) are valid in the prohibited times; qaḍāʾ has a prior cause.

janazah.basis: Janāzah has a present cause; valid in the prohibited times.

causalNafl.basis: Nafl with a cause (taḥiyyat al-masjid, sunnah of wuḍūʾ) is valid in the prohibited times.

pureNafl.basis: Pure nafl with no cause is invalid in the prohibited times.
